description: The options of useFakeTimers() under each runner's own names: which globals stay real (Jest doNotFake, Vitest toFake and toNotFake, each ignoring the other's names), the loop limit (Jest timerLimit, Vitest loopLimit; defaults 100000 and 10000), advancing with real time (Jest advanceTimers, Vitest shouldAdvanceTime and advanceTimeDelta), and clearing a native timer through a fake clearTimeout. Each case is one observation.
